complexity_review: Process hats with a fresh subset-of-people DP layer, preventing double use of a hat. O(40*n*2^n) time and O(2^n+40*n) space; modular additions remain exactly representable in JS.
evidence_scope: prospective finite public-domain output/type/local-effects qualification, not universal proof
objective: Assign each person one preferred hat with no repeated hat across people; count assignments modulo 1000000007.
official_domain: 1<=people<=10; each list has 1..40 unique integer hat labels from 1 through 40.
provenance: Owner-provided existing implementations, independently reviewed against official public statement; original files unchanged.
